title: Completion Intake
description: Work reported complete by the party that did it: who, how much in the work's unit, the IFC elements and the place (readPoint, a location URI -- a voxel cell vox.i.j.k where the work is in one), and the takt. A completion is a claim for verification, not a verification: a gate reads it with the evidence and decides. No money and no identity beyond the performer's party URI. Every instance must also validate against GS1's EPCIS 2.0.1 JSON Schema; this profile only narrows it, and its top level is closed.

performerRef.description: The party whose work is complete: the trade, vendor, equipment owner or robot operator that did it.

quantity.description: How much was completed, in the work's unit (EA trapezes, MTR of conduit, MTK of ceiling).

elementGuids.description: The IFC elements completed, by GlobalId.

attestation.description: observed: a device or record saw it; attested: the performer states it.
